signals.text: 4 open PM roles across 1 US office
Recently added to Tolara — hiring trends need a week of history

bullets: Own the end-to-end experience our customers have with our AI agents, from first interaction to completed outcome
Own agent quality as a product: evaluation frameworks, review loops, and the metrics that define "good" for a production agent
Own the division of labor between agents and people, where automation earns more autonomy, and where human judgment stays in the workflow
Own the improvement engine: the feedback loops and mechanisms that make agents measurably better every week, at growing volume
Define, prioritize, and execute the roadmap for our agentic product experiences
Own strategy, roadmap and results for Ande's marketplace, across every category of corporate entertainment we offer
Lead, coach and grow a team of product managers, and hire the next PMs as the portfolio expands
Run the portfolio like a business: make clear investment calls across categories and hold each one to ambitious goals
Bring new categories to market and grow the ones we have
Build relationships with key partners, and own the integrations that make their offerings part of Ande
Own product strategy and roadmap for a product line serving the teams who plan and host corporate events
Own the end-to-end experience, from initial planning and booking through the day itself, and everything that happens after
Own how our AI works inside that experience: what it takes on, where people stay in control, and how work moves between the two
Own the product's foundation: the core objects it's built on, and how it connects to the systems our customers already run their business on
Work hand in hand with founding customers: run discovery, put early versions in front of them every week, and turn what you learn into what ships next
Own product strategy and roadmap for our payments platform, with a focus on supplier-facing workflows
Own the payment experiences our suppliers touch, from getting paid to understanding their money
Own payment partner and banking integrations, the rails everything else runs on
Own the internal tooling behind our payment operations, supporting the team that keeps payouts, reconciliation, and exceptions running smoothly
Own new financial product initiatives: receivables, analytics, and whatever we discover our customers need next
